findings.desc: docs/requirements/decisions/lifecycle-artifact-scope.md:31 says only KOALA_LIFECYCLE_ARTIFACT_RELATIVE_PATHS admits nested lifecycle paths and lines 35-37/79-83 overclaim that only evidence/transcript-diff.md is allowed under evidence/, but packages/main/src/core/lifecycle-registry.ts:655 still accepts any nested path whose basename is in KOALA_LIFECYCLE_ARTIFACT_FILENAMES (for example evidence/summary.json or evidence/test-evidence.json). Update the truth-source wording or tighten classifyLifecycleArtifact so the docs stop overclaiming the scope narrowing. severity=medium
